title: MULTI³NLU++: A Multilingual, Multi-Intent, Multi-Domain Dataset for Natural Language Understanding in Task-Oriented Dialogue

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing task-oriented dialogue NLU performance (F1 scores for intent detection and slot labeling) across high-, medium-, and low-resource languages (Spanish, Marathi, Turkish, and Amharic) to demonstrate representational disparities and performance gaps in multilingual language models.
